7112b604bbee926a02f363237f02a7259565075d perf: reuse owned layer captures and reject absent ladder visuals
scope: Fix measured render regression while retaining owned semantic data, ordered owner commands, resource/exception/stale/lifetime checks and sole Lua Platform v1. Dense759monster carrier is primary.

diagnosis.evidence: Existing125Hz samples undersampled monmove. Two diagnostic3999Hz captures, native state verified; no timing claim from high-frequency runs. Full symbols/unknown frames retained.
causes_and_opportunities: Owned layer views were freshly constructed/destroyed per tile/layer. Preserve their value boundary while reusing frame-local string capacity; terrain/trap empty override maps also avoid impossible neighbor probes.

Furniture capture repeatedly asks about vehicle ladder visuals. When the existing projected-ladder index is empty and the authoritative in-bounds vehicle occupancy bits are clear, ladder visuals are impossible; skip submap/furniture reads. Occupied, projected-ladder and unknown-bounds cases keep complete legacy validation.

Movement commit already obtains the live tracker registration pin at its captured position. An additional is_present query before any owner mutation repeats that same check; consolidate into the retained pin identity/position/liveness check. All later action/Lua/context stale checks remain.
diagnosis.attribution_limit: The combined candidate is measured, not an independent speedup for each line. Do not attribute the entire historical monmove delta to one validation query or infer exact function timings from sparse samples.

implementation.semantic_values: IDs/text/coordinates/light/category remain owned values. Existing optional-return captures remain available; reusable output is read only on success and refreshes every semantic field.
implementation.frame_lifetime: Each root draw binds its own capacity buffer and restores enclosing binding on return/exception. No borrowed world/SDL pointer enters semantic DTOs or worker output.
implementation.no_decision_cache: Only string storage is reused, never visibility/preview/memory/world decisions. The map fast rejection uses the existing live map-owned cache; no second invalidation mechanism.
implementation.safety: Renderer epoch/frame/sequence checks, early/late validation, cancel/unwind, cache readiness, owner ordering, identity/liveness and post-hook membership checks are retained. Registration predicate is consolidated, not bypassed.
implementation.threading: No new AI/render worker activation. VISION4/RENDER0 unchanged; gameplay/Lua/RNG/SDL stay on their prior owners.
implementation.public_contract: No save/schema/JSON/Lua/API/generated contract change; require("ccb") Platform v1 only.

allocation_evidence.case: Actual production view;1000longID/subcategory fresh constructions vs1000warm assignments, assertions enabled.
allocation_evidence.native_and_scoped_asan_ubsan_lsan: passed; owned retained copy and every semantic field checked
allocation_evidence.limit: Not a game timing or whole-game allocator proof. Longer future values may still allocate; normal exception propagation/owner unwind retained.
allocation_evidence.reuse: 52allocation proof and all relevant source hashes unchanged in53.

validation.sanitizer_limits: Actual affected units instrumented within recorded private CMake scopes; other common modules linked Release. Map target includes actual map.cpp and layer/destination tests. No whole-game or live-map concurrent safety proof.
coverage: Visible/memory/preview capture reuse updates all fields without corrupting retained values or consuming RNG.
Actual air vehicle ladder visual creation, top/below identity, furniture blocking, restoration and vehicle destruction.
Source replacement at same position and source moved while still registered reject; existing conflict/dead/removed/target/Platform v1 callback/recovery/reload/pixel cases retained.
validation.full_gameplay: Matrix full normalized player/active_monsters payload SHA matches across all15combat/all10carrier/all6field/all6room runs; only learned-recipe/event row ordering, save wall-time metadata and exact verified build version identities normalized. Event count/first/last totals preserved.
validation.profile_quality: All37collector exits0 and lost-event scans0. External-process violation pairs discarded per predeclared rule and retained raw. Passing run input and complete state checked independently of timing. Low-sample functions do not establish a precise function speedup.

Preserve counts/first/last and all other selected gameplay arrays/stats. Native save footers and full decoded memory JSON independently audited.

delivery_conclusion: Dense carrier drawing is faster than both regressed51 and pre34 with both rebuilt/reused paired95 below0. Exploration carrier also improves vs51. Dense monmove is back near pre34, no demonstrated AI acceleration or equivalence. Ordinary field/room intervals cross0, no stable change claim.
